name: castle
description: A local-first desktop and web application for Markdown knowledge bases.

scripts.generate:contracts: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p castle-contracts --bin export-contracts -- packages/contracts/src/castle_contract_schema.json && npm run generate --workspace @castle/contracts
scripts.generate:content: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p castle-snapshot -- build --profile desktop --public apps/desktop/public && node scripts/check-snapshot-profile.mjs desktop apps/desktop/public
scripts.generate:content:web: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p castle-snapshot -- build --profile public --public apps/web/public && node scripts/check-snapshot-profile.mjs public apps/web/public
scripts.generate: npm run sync:person-locations && npm run generate:contracts && npm run generate:content && npm run generate:icons
scripts.validate:library: npm run check:person-locations && cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p castle-cli -- validate
scripts.dev:viewer: npm run generate && npm run dev --workspace @castle/desktop
scripts.dev:web: npm run generate:content:web && npm run dev --workspace @castle/web
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run generate && npm run start --workspace @castle/desktop
scripts.lint:web: npm run check:architecture && eslint --max-warnings=0 apps packages scripts
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:native
scripts.build:viewer: npm run check:person-locations && npm run generate:contracts && npm run generate:content && npm run generate:icons && npm run build --workspace @castle/desktop
scripts.build:web: npm run check:person-locations && npm run generate:content:web && npm run build --workspace @castle/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:native && npm run test && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:web && npm run typecheck
scripts.package:desktop: npm run generate && npm run package --workspace @castle/desktop
scripts.make:desktop: npm run generate && npm run make --workspace @castle/desktop
scripts.deploy: node apps/web/scripts/check-private-deploy.mjs && npm run check && wrangler deploy --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
